# TreeTech

TreeTech builds AI automation systems, CRM workflows, websites, custom web applications and business process automation for companies in Austria.

## Services

- AI automation
- Business process automation
- CRM workflows and integrations
- Websites and landing pages
- Custom web applications
- AI chatbots and internal assistants
- Lead management and contact workflows
